benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Up to $25 in statement credits each month ($300 per year) for purchases at restaurants worldwide, including select food delivery services.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month, does not roll over if unused. Eligible for restaurants worldwide and select delivery providers such as DoorDash, Grubhub, and Uber Eats.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: $100 property credit for qualifying charges when booking a stay of at least 2 nights directly at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis.
benefits.terms: Requires a 2-night minimum stay booked directly with the property.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, including a 50% bonus on points earned, complimentary room upgrades, 4pm late checkout, and lounge access at some properties.
benefits.terms: 50% bonus on base points earned on eligible stays. Room upgrades and lounge access subject to availability.

benefits.name: 25 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 25 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status each calendar year, stackable with nights earned from actual stays.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: 1 Free Night Award, redeemable at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, issued each year upon card renewal.
benefits.terms: Issued automatically each year on card renewal, not spend-based. Can be topped up with up to 15,000 additional personal points for stays up to 100,000 points. Certain hotels charge resort fees not covered by the award.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with unlimited visits to participating airport lounges for the cardholder and up to two guests.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus up to two guests per visit.

benefits.terms: Lounge access only; does not include Priority Pass restaurant/experience credits at participating airports.

benefits.name: Trip Delay, Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for reasonable expenses and prepaid, non-refundable travel costs when a covered trip is delayed, cancelled, or interrupted.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on bags on trips paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card and the rental company's collision damage waiver is declined.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against accidental damage or theft for 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
